# OG Xbox TU1.5 cinematic depth-of-field state oracle

This optional local JSON is original-derived evidence and stays ignored. The test compiles without it and returns77 when it or either required asset is absent. A present malformed, incomplete, failed or wrong-version fixture fails the test.

Generate it from the authenticated English TU1.5 executable and the fourteen original campaign maps:

```sh
.tools/python/bin/python tools/generate_campaign_dof_fixture.py \
  --xbe "/path/to/Halo 2 DLC/content/u5English/default.xbe" \
  --maps-directory assets/disc/maps
```

The Python runtime needs Capstone and Unicorn plus this repository's existing XBE/cache readers. The generator pins executable SHA256 `21b207e7efdacaf6124a0822837f8be570766a42505057f7fd2d2ba8f409c4fd`, authenticates64 authored call/function/seven-REAL node chains, and executes the unchanged scalar-table initializer and whole HS dispatcher/parser/completion. It also records70 raw-value/null-owner setter cases,36 complete timed-screen updates,16 bounded original render-admission cases and10 original depth-range consumer cases. No original instruction, game return, callee result or GPU success is supplied or patched. Existing differing outputs are preserved and rejected.

Run `campaign_depth_of_field_tu15_tests TU15_XBE assets/disc/maps/00a_introduction.map tests/fixtures/retail_cinematic_dof_tu15.json` after building. CTest `native_campaign_authored_depth_of_field_tu15` uses those explicit paths and skip code77.

The native test compares full source screen banks and original raw-word behavior, calls the authentic Introduction host using a declared isolated nine-node VM envelope, and verifies source lifecycle, clock, checkpoints, recording/replay and read-only rejection. It verifies the two scene depth/target recipe values. Vulkan near/far render targets, source filtering/compositing, texture geometry, resolution scaling and matched OG Xbox TU1.5 framebuffer evidence remain separate integration requirements.
